dark-void-scene.title: Dark Void Navigator
dark-void-scene.reason: Not a Golden voxel-collision app by design - a dialog+look-based navigator experience with no wall-collision movement, so it does not (and should not) implement the Golden UI shell/physics contract project-quality-reviewer.js requires of a 'certified' entry. Already live and verified in production at dark-void-navigator.vercel.app and re-verified end-to-end locally this session (real scene renders, zero console errors, desktop mouse-look and mobile dual-joystick controls confirmed) - registered here only so the deny-by-default release registry recognizes the directory; kept out of the internal 3D-games catalog listing (visible:false) rather than mislabeled as Golden-certified.
